attempted_claim: Let T be a linearly recurrent interval-exchange transformation, let N≥3, and let 0<ζ₁<ζ₂<1. For pairwise distinct a₁,a₂,a₃∈Z/NZ, define f=a₁·1_[0,ζ₁)+a₂·1_[ζ₁,ζ₂)+a₃·1_[ζ₂,1). If the cyclic skew product T_f(x,s)=(Tx,s+f(x)) is minimal, must T_f be uniquely ergodic without assuming the full-ramification hypothesis used in Ferenczi–Hubert's Theorem 17?
decisive_failure: Target work used one consolidated literature call (Ferenczi-Hubert arxiv:2103.09018 full text) plus local deduction and bounded computation only; no second search was needed. The YES direction was not pursued beyond identifying that Lemma 19 essentially uses full ramification, and the NO direction was not pursued beyond the documented R2 factor search and R3 family computation, so a future separating-curve argument with disconnected preimages or a novel three-valued construction remains untested. All negative results are bounded-route findings, not impossibility theorems.
